clean_reference.jpg.creation_method: PIL RGB canvas single-pass compression at Q=95
clean_reference.jpg.known_limitations: Synthetic flat gradient; baseline for unmanipulated noise/compression.

clean_reference.png.creation_method: PIL RGB canvas lossless PNG compression
clean_reference.png.known_limitations: Lossless container; frequency DCT and ELA compression analyses are mathematically inapplicable.

clean_reference.webp.creation_method: PIL WebP lossy compression at Q=90
clean_reference.webp.known_limitations: WebP compression differs from standard JPEG DCT tables.

metadata_known_camera.jpg.creation_method: PIL JPEG with explicit hardware EXIF tags (Canon EOS 80D)
metadata_known_camera.jpg.known_limitations: Simulated EXIF headers without proprietary maker note blocks.

metadata_stripped.jpg.creation_method: PIL JPEG saved without EXIF dictionary
metadata_stripped.jpg.known_limitations: Absence of EXIF is characteristic of web optimization or privacy stripping.

recompressed_double_jpeg.jpg.known_limitations: Global uniform recompression without spatial splicing.

synthetic_copy_move.jpg.creation_method: Synthetic cloned feature patch placed at (40,40) and (220,220)

localized_splice_ela.jpg.creation_method: Q=60 background spliced with uncompressed patch and saved at Q=95
localized_splice_ela.jpg.known_limitations: High contrast boundary designed for ELA error surface validation.

malformed_header.jpg.creation_method: Synthetic byte injection corrupting JPEG scan headers
malformed_header.jpg.known_limitations: Cannot be parsed by valid JPEG decoders.

malformed_header.png.creation_method: Invalid PNG IHDR chunk and bad CRC bytes
malformed_header.png.known_limitations: Cannot be parsed by valid PNG decoders.

truncated.jpg.creation_method: Valid JPEG byte stream truncated at 33% length
truncated.jpg.known_limitations: Missing EOI marker and incomplete entropy-coded scan data.

unsupported.txt.known_limitations: MIME type text/plain must be rejected by image ingest.

tiny_2x2.png.known_limitations: Sub-block geometry (smaller than 8x8 DCT grid or 16x16 noise block).

unusual_aspect_10x1000.jpg.known_limitations: High aspect ratio tests block partitioning and memory allocation boundaries.
